cards.name: Apple AirTag 2 (4-pack)
cards.price: $99 for four, $29 for one (Apple list prices, apple.com, 2026) · often about 20% less on sale
cards.chip: Louder · finds from 50% farther · Apple Watch finding
cards.buy_if: you have an iPhone and keys, a wallet, luggage or a kid's backpack that goes missing.
cards.skip_if: you're on Android — it won't pair. Get the Chipolo Pop instead.
cards.owners: Reviewers measured it much louder (about 85 dB against 66 dB) and found it easier to find. Complaints: still no keyring hole, and the same coin battery.
cards.video_title: AirTag 2 review — what's different vs AirTag 1? (Brian Tong)

cards.name: Chipolo Pop
cards.badge: Best for Android and mixed homes
cards.chip: Apple Find My or Google Find Hub · keyring hole · 120 dB
cards.buy_if: your household mixes iPhones and Androids, or you want a hole for the keyring.
cards.skip_if: you want the on-screen arrows — only AirTag does Precision Finding on iPhone.
cards.owners: Owners like the loud ring and the hole. Complaint: no precision finding.

cards.name: Samsung Galaxy SmartTag2
cards.chip: SmartThings Find · UWB on Galaxy · built-in loop
cards.buy_if: you carry a Samsung Galaxy phone.
cards.skip_if: you don't — it pairs only with Samsung phones.
cards.owners: Owners praise the range and the built-in loop. Complaint: Samsung-only.
